flavor: Thick, yellow smoke curls around the obsidian pillars, obscuring the floor in a low-hanging haze. At the center, a massive iron cage glows a dull, angry red, containing a flickering silhouette that pulses in time with the heat radiating from the cracked stone walls.
name: The Sulfur-Choked Reliquary
reason: The party encounters a bound fire elementalist creature trapped within a heat-warped cage, offering forbidden secrets in exchange for cooling reagents or blood.
